i.bar: Spearman >= 0.9 between the store's FDI and FDI from MARIDA's own bands, MARIDA 'Marine Water' pixels, per 20 m cell

ii.bar: |F1(store FDI) - F1(MARIDA FDI)| <= 0.05, threshold = 95th percentile of TRAIN Marine Water FDI, debris-vs-not on MARIDA's TEST split
